integrity: Exact analytical proof plus numerical checks for m=1 and m=2; calculations are not proofs of the arbitrary-m theorem. No independent mathematical audit or global priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Proved for one-complex-dimensional standard Gaussian Fock concentration and indicator masks with finitely many concentric annular components. The unique balanced design is unique for the first 2m modal eigenvalues equal to one-half; no general nonradial claim. Classical sign-quadrature antecedents pose residual historical-priority risk.
title: Sharp spectral multiplicity and exact half-energy designs for Gaussian localization on concentric annuli
